source_evidence: Exact player 'Yes, and we will also need to inspect the record here… as well as tour my estate.' accepts Voss's offer to arrange an audience with Lady Caul, requests record inspection and tour of claimed tower. Voss corrects ownership jokingly as prospective, voluntarily grants supervised historical archive access and ordinary tower tour. He writes a request to Lady Caul describing V's stated identity/rival claim and corroborated historical station authority, requesting a personal audience; existing roof Scout is summoned and departs with message ~16:10 on established12 rough-path-mile route to manor, approximately8 hours ordinary travel, arrival no earlier than ~00:10 Day334 at uninterrupted pace, actual arrival/response/scheduled audience pending; no extra courier or replacement, no report of undisclosed Silverward location, heart or private genealogy. Existing hall Guard still en route to road patrol with prior suspension order, earliest20:05; no confirmed receipt/compliance. Tower now contains Voss, gate Guard and archive Spy, no new forces. Cirren meaningfully Helps with argument for current collection records. Predeclared V Persuasion +7 advantage DC16 to secure access to current accounts in addition to already granted historical archive/tour. Genuine visible Python secrets receipt batch b5a10b053cd46ba297b0bbd65cce0e19, d20 faces9,10 keep10+7=17 succeeds. Voss permits supervised relevant current record inspection. Actual original tenant exemption in existing cellar chest and seized-grain tallies in hall cupboard are examined and compared with current collection instructions and previously corroborated oath-book; fixed prepared evidence in ashen-regency-field-operations-dm-only.md @6b58329ad8c128c24fd903edbfa0234362505e3c. Cirren identifies documented original tenant protection omitted from current instructions and grain charges despite applicable protections. Voss cannot dispute the evidence, but no specific author, confession of personal culpability, full criminal proof, exact household identities, amounts or full restitution established. Cirren makes supervised copies of relevant historical/modern record entries (originals retained by station, no document surrendered or removed). V/Cirren/Fenar follow Voss on ordinary supervised tour of fixed square40ft tower, ground hall/administration/stores, upper archive, cellar secure storage, roof parapet and entrance court/iron gate. Only observed functions/geometry, no hidden culvert disclosed, exact estate land acreage, asset valuation, new inventory quantities, modern ownership or title certified. Roof now unstaffed while Scout away, no replacement. Mara remains with healthy coach/four horses in courtyard. No roll for routine reading or tour, no payment, fight, initiative, additional quest reward, general closure of road collection operation or title transfer. Elapsed ~55 minutes, D333~17:00, next V choice. Voss offers to continue discussions, no appointment confirmed.
